fields.Name: T157 - Algorithm Catalog Detail Expand
fields.Description: Exercises the per-card inline detail toggle + hyperparameter JSON parsing — a distinct branch from the scenario re-ranking behavior.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and select the 'Algorithm Catalog' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. On any algorithm card, click its 'Details' button. Success is an inline detail panel expanding within that card showing the algorithm's driver class, problem types, and its default hyperparameters (or a 'sensible defaults' note). Clicking 'Details' again should collapse it. Seeing the detail panel toggle open is success — you do NOT need to click 'Use'.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Details' on an algorithm card expands an inline detail panel with driver class / problem types / hyperparameters
The detail panel is a distinct expandable section (toggles closed when clicked again)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
